système d'information de gestion de l'éducation
sistema de informação de gestão da educação

sub_indicators.label: Education information system
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.mis
sub_indicators.norm_short: The AU Digital Education Strategy asks for education management information systems to move from aggregate school returns to records for each learner, teacher and school.
criteria: A source from the past three years says there is no education management information system.
The education ministry procured, piloted or is building an education management information system.
The ministry collected or published an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.
The system holds individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.
Learner records are linked to the national ID or birth registration number, or exchange data with another government system.
